elements.title: Privacy-Boosting Mechanisms

figure.caption: Stochastic block sampling strategy to prevent model extraction.

bullets: Sample-level permutations shuffle data at every block to hide sample mappings
Stochastic Block Sampling (SBS) reveals only a subset of non-consecutive outputs
Defenses make model extraction computationally infeasible for malicious clients

builds.audio_segment: BlindFed thwarts model extraction with two defenses.
Sample-level permutations shuffle data at every block to hide sample mappings.
Simultaneously, Stochastic Block Sampling reveals only a subset of non-consecutive outputs.
This breaks representation continuity, making it computationally infeasible for clients to reconstruct the model.
